title: Large serialized JSON responses
summary: Rails endpoints serialize full ActiveRecord objects or large associations without field selection.
rationale: Over-serialization increases database access, CPU, memory, and network payload size.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Use serializers with sparse fields, pagination, and explicit association loading.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
